summary: The custody pilot for FS-GG/.github#4710 (C-J1) is the separate workflow .github/workflows/wasm-custody-pilot.yml, job custody-pilot. It runs only on workflow_dispatch; pull requests run static controls. It executes pilot_sequence from the inline caller in fable-reference-public.yml at the same commit, inside one sudo systemd-run delegated unit (TasksMax=4096, MemoryMax=8G, RuntimeMaxSec=1800), with a 30-minute job timeout, contents: read and no secrets. pilot_sequence refuses unless all of these hold: a same-repository main dispatch, admitted_ref equal to the dispatched and checked-out commit, the recorded admission URL (#4710 comment 6346457201), the pilot workflow identity, and run attempt 1. It then loads the pinned managed-group owner (ac22206, d846dbe1...) and probes containment before any acquisition. It provisions only the browser subset: the 0.19.1 template locks, Node/npm, the stock Playwright 1.63 seed and the five pinned browser archives, with stock host validation. It then runs, as require-empty custody groups under a non-renewed custody deadline, a Chromium library scan (host ldd) and three cases for each of chromium headless-shell 1243, firefox 1543 (content sandbox enabled) and webkit 2359: normal (stock runner plus vite preview webServer), forced (held past a 25 s group deadline) and leader-exit. Each case is classified in custody-pilot.json, and a case counts only when its group was contained and removed. Evidence is capped at 45 MiB and hashed, uploaded once, kept 30 days. Installed C stays held (RUNTIME_ADMITTED=False, two literal-false steps, custody_gate). Lesson: fresh_environment already owns root/evidence, so the pilot uses root/pilot-evidence. This record describes the source, not a run outcome.
title: Dispatch-only three-family WASM custody pilot is admitted for exactly one run
